newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Spectrum EGM to approve 1 for 10 shr consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Spectrum EGM to approve 1 for 10 shr consolidation.

text.p: Spectrum Resources Ltd on Thursday said it would hold an Extraordinary General Meeting on October 24 to seek shareholder approval for a one for 10 consolidation of all ordinary shares, reregistration and adoption of a new constitution.
Since the EGM of shareholders held on July 5, Spectrum had, in a series of placements through Canaccord Capital Corporation of Vancouver, Canada, issued 18.5 million new shares to raise NZ$647,500.
"The funds raised will be utilised principally to progress the Vietnamese nickel project," Spectrum said in a statement.

"Subject to weather conditions and contractor availability it is anticipated a diamond drilling program of approximately 10 holes aggregating 1,000 metres will commence at Ban Phuc in Vietnam in about mid October."
